pattern: ところを見ると（ところをみると）
purpose: Infer a situation from an observed action or fact.
keywords: Plain clause + ところを見ると
Judging by the umbrella she is carrying, it seems to be raining outside.
Judging by his repeatedly checking the time, he must be in a hurry.
Judging by the empty plates, the food seems to have been popular.
formation: Plain clause + ところを見ると
restrictions: The preceding observation provides a visible basis for inference.
mistake: It does not mean literally looking at a location.
